jen: Quick check 18: partner Terraform checklist for marketplace modules. Need a minimal CI baseline: fmt/validate, tflint, checkov, and optional smoke test behind a label. Keep PR feedback useful for forked contributions.

naveen: +1. Suggest two-mode CI: static (always) and integration (label flips). Static should run without cloud creds.

maria: Also require MODULE_INTERFACE.md with required inputs (region, env, tags) and outputs (endpoint, module_id). Add examples/minimal and COSTS.md.

jen: Draft PR template: add checklist items, how to request integration run, cost note, and packaging steps (redwood_registry.yml).

ci-bot: Created PART-1299: "Marketplace module CI baseline" (assignee: jen).

naveen: Action items: Naveen -> sample tflint + checkov configs. Maria -> module interface doc + example. Jen -> seed repo + PR template.

jen: I'll push a starter under github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-iac-starter by EOD Friday. Ping me for a seed module. :rocket:
